newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Daewoo to join Vietnam BOT road project.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo to join Vietnam BOT road project.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Corp has been chosen to help finance a build-operate-transfer project for a 130-km (81-mile) highway between Ho Chi Minh City and the port of Vung Tau, Vietnam's official Evening News said on Tuesday.
It said Daewoo had signed a contract with Australian engineering consultancy Maunsell to work on a plan for the $376-million project, which will be financed through a low-interest, long-term loan.
The report did not name any other investors.
Construction of the highway is expected to start by the end of this year and be completed two years later, the Evening News said.
Officials at Daewoo, the largest single foreign investor in Vietnam with about $700 million committed to various projects, were not available to comment on the report.
